CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to any identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue coordinate sets), an explicit organization/presentation field (origin), and separate status-origin metadata are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colored contents (red/blue) with coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origins and explicit status flags (e.g. executed_branch_claim:false, kinds like completed_record vs history_estimate) separately attribute status/organization to contents.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/organization metadata (kinds, inherited_current, executed_branch_claim) describe how contents are presented or generated.
